status: Proposed next evaluation generation spec, fixed from development outputs only (C-003 smoke, C-004 preflight) before any final-test run. Not tuned on final-test results. Owner of adoption: supervisor.

evidence.c003_output_cap_256: Explanation items truncated at 256 tokens: Qwen3-1.7B 5/5, Kanana-1.5-2.1B 3/5; Kanana completed explanations used 191 and 231 tokens. 256 is therefore not a completion-safe cap.
evidence.c004_preflight_dev: 380 development prompts (RAG310 310, pilot 30, institution probe 40): input tokens trid p50 368 / max 959, Qwen3 p50 486 / max 1336, Kanana p50 439 / max 1200. Same text costs about 1.2-1.3x more tokens on the comparison tokenizers. All reference answers fit every model's room.

primary.name: full-document, identical input
primary.input: Same passages, question and work instruction for every model; each model's official chat template; thinking disabled where the template supports it; greedy (temperature 0).

trid.note: trid's trained context is 1,024 tokens, so its output room is what the input leaves (development minimum 65). This is a property of the model, recorded per item, not hidden.

primary.denominator: Every planned item for every model. input_exceeds (input alone does not fit), exceptions and truncated outputs stay in the denominator and are reported separately; they are never removed from the primary metric.

auxiliary.name: common-context subset
auxiliary.rule: items whose trid input + 512 <= 1024 and whose other-model inputs + 512 fit their serving context; all models capped at 512 new tokens
auxiliary.purpose: compare reading at equal output budget; reported separately, never replaces primary

auxiliary.name: equal-budget note
auxiliary.rule: token caps are per tokenizer; equal token counts are not equal text lengths

decoding: No value-copy constraint in the free-text explanation evaluation; the value-copy decoder remains the default product path and is evaluated separately with the value-format metric.
not_changed: No re-run of the C-003 10 items; no final-test items used.
